caption:
India's commerce minister says a $1 trillion export target is within reach. And the first half of the year backs him up.

At the 31st CII Partnership Summit curtain-raiser on October 8, 2026, Piyush Goyal said India remains on course for $1 trillion in combined exports in FY27 - 16% above FY26's record $863.11 billion. April-August exports already hit $399.27 billion, up 15.55% YoY, with August alone up 25.41%.

A trillion-dollar target used to sound aspirational. Halfway through the year, the math says it's just arithmetic now.

Sources: Free Press Journal, Maritime Gateway (2026)
